author: bardic-inspiration
name: Deathbound Zealot
summary: A scarred, hollow-eyed fighter who has already died once for the cult and fights as though it was nothing.
description: Deathbound zealots are bound by a rite that tethers a sliver of their life to the grave. Their commanders say the rite takes nothing the zealot would have kept, which is the sort of thing commanders say.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The zealot makes two Rusted Cleaver attacks.

reactions.name: Last Rite
reactions.text: Trigger: The zealot is reduced to 0 hit points. Response: The zealot makes one Rusted Cleaver attack against a creature within its reach, then falls.
